1.text: Hashize iminsi itanu, umutambyi mukuru Ananiya amanukana n'abakuru bamwe n'uwo kubaburanira witwaga Teritulo, babwira umutegeka mukuru ibyo barega Pawulo.

2.text: Bamaze kumuhamagara, Teritulo aramurega ati“Nyakubahwa Feliki, ni wowe dukesha aya mahoro, kandi n'ibindi byatunganirijwe ubu bwoko ku bw'umwete wawe.

3.text: Nuko turabyakira hose iminsi yose, tugushima cyane.

4.text: Ariko ndeke kukurambira, ndakwinginga utwumve ku bw'ineza yawe, tuvuge amagambo make.

5.text: Twabonye uyu muntu ari icyago, agomesha abantu bo mu Bayuda bose bari mu bihugu byose, kandi ni we mutware w'igice cyitwa icy'Abanazareti.

6.text: Ndetse yagerageje guhumanya urusengero. Nuko turamufata, [dushaka kumucira urubanza nk'uko amategeko yacu ari.

7.text: Ariko umutware w'ingabo Lusiya araza amutwakisha amaboko,

8.text: ategeka abarezi be kukuzaho.] Nawe umubajije ubwawe, wabasha kumenya ibyo tumureze byose.”

9.text: Abayuda na bo bamurega bimwe n'ibyo, bavuga ko ari ko biri koko.

10.text: Umutegeka mukuru amaze kumurembuza ngo avuge, Pawulo aramusubiza ati“Nzi yuko umaze imyaka myinshi uri umucamanza w'ubu bwoko. Ni cyo gitumye niregura ibyanjye nezerewe,

11.text: kuko ubasha kumenya yuko iminsi itarasaga cumi n'ibiri, uhereye aho nagiriye i Yerusalemu gusengerayo.

12.text: Kandi ntibasanze njya impaka n'umuntu wese, cyangwa ngo nteranye abantu kubatera imidugararo, naho haba mu rusengero cyangwa mu masinagogi cyangwa mu murwa.

13.text: Kandi ibyo bandeze none ntibashobora kubihamya imbere yawe ko ari iby'ukuri.

14.text: Ariko ndakwemerera iki, yuko iyo Nzira aba bita igice, ari yo ngenderamo nkorera Imana ya ba sogokuruza, nizeye ibyanditswe mu mategeko byose no mu byahanuwe.

15.text: Kandi niringiye Imana, ntegereje icyo aba na bo bategereza, yuko hazabaho kuzuka kw'abakiranutsi n'abakiranirwa.

16.text: Ni cyo gituma mpirimbanira kugira umutima utandega ikibi, ngirira Imana cyangwa abantu iminsi yose.

17.text: “Nuko imyaka myinshi ishize, ndaza nzanira ab'ubwoko bwacu iby'ubuntu, kandi ntura amaturo.

18.text: Nkiri muri ibyo bansanga mu rusengero nezwa, ari nta bantu nteranije, kandi nta n'urusaku ruriho. Ariko hariho Abayuda bamwe bavuye muri Asiya,

19.text: ari bo bari bakwiriye kukuzaho bakandega, iyo babona ikibi kuri jye.

20.text: Cyangwa aba na bo nibavuge icyaha bambonyeho ngihagaze imbere y'urukiko,

21.text: uretse ijambo rimwe navuze mpagaze muri bo nti ‘Kuzuka kw'abapfuye ni ko kunzanye muri izi manza zanyu uyu munsi.’ ”

22.text: Maze Feliki kuko arusha abandi kumenya iby'iyo Nzira arabirazika ati “Lusiya umutware w'ingabo namara kuza, nzaca urubanza rw'amagambo yanyu.”

23.text: Ategeka umutware utwara umutwe kurindisha Pawulo amaso, no kutabuza umuntu wese mu ncuti ze kumukorera.

24.text: Bukeye Feliki azana n'umugore we Dirusila w'Umuyudakazi, atumira Pawulo yumva ibyo avuga byo kwizera Kristo Yesu.

25.text: Akivuga ibyo gukiranuka n'ibyo kwirinda n'iby'amateka azacibwa, Feliki aratinya cyane aramusubiza ati “None genda, nimbona uburyo nzagutumira.”

26.text: Kandi yiringiraga ko Pawulo azamuhongera impiya. Ni cyo cyatumye ahora amutumira ngo baganire.

27.text: Imyaka ibiri ishize, Porukiyo Fesito akura Feliki. Kandi Feliki ashatse kunezeza Abayuda, asiga Pawulo aboshywe.
